It connects the eastern Indian seaport of Kolkata with the Sittwe seaport in Rakhine State, Myanmar, by sea. From Sittwe, it links to Paletwa in Myanmar via the Kaladan river boat route, and then from Paletwa to Mizoram (India) by road.

2. **Strategic Importance:**

   Currently, the only land route connecting the Northeast region of India with the rest of the country is through the narrow Siliguri Corridor (also known as the "Chicken's Neck").    $$\text{Relative Speed} = V_t - V_m = 63\text{ km/hr} - 3\text{ km/hr} = 60\text{ km/hr}$$
